overview: Host Laura Duggan and guest Stephen Duggan presented a travelogue of their cruise down the Mississippi River to New Orleans, detailing historical landmarks, cultural activities, and regional history.

items.title: Introduction to Going Down the Mississippi and New Orleans
items.summary: Hostess Laura Duggan introduced her husband and co-adventurer, Stephen Duggan, to share their travelogue documenting their journey down the Mississippi River.

items.title: Riverboat Technology and Navigation
items.summary: The presenters described the design, specialized propulsion system, and navigation challenges of their Viking riverboat.

items.title: River Commerce and Geography
items.summary: The presenters detailed the vast scale of commercial barge traffic, geographic features of the river, and historical flood control measures managed by the Army Corps of Engineers.

items.title: Greenville, Mississippi Tourism and Culture
items.summary: The presenters highlighted their stop in Greenville, discussing the local music history, regional food, and the town's resurgence through cruise tourism.

items.title: Vicksburg Civil War Battlefield and Artifacts
items.summary: The presenters reviewed the Civil War history of Vicksburg, showcasing battlefield statues, local military grave sites, and the salvaged USS Cairo ironclad ship.

items.title: Natchez and Longwood Estate
items.summary: The presenters described their tour of Natchez, including the unfinished octagonal Longwood Estate and historic plantation quarters detailing early cotton production.

items.title: Oakley Plantation and Audubon
items.summary: The presenters highlighted John James Audubon's history as a tutor at Oakley Plantation, historic blacksmith demonstrations, and plantation domestic life.

items.title: Cajun Swamp Tour and Voodoo Queen Legend
items.summary: The presenters shared their experiences on a Louisiana swamp boat tour, detailing wildlife sightings and the legend of voodoo queen Julia Brown.

items.title: New Orleans Landmarks, Dining, and Jazz
items.summary: The presenters showcased New Orleans architecture, historic hotels, local dining, and street musicians performing during the city's jazz festival.

items.title: Behind-the-Scenes Crew Perspectives
items.summary: Station managers Kevin Harrington and Jim joined the set to share their own travel stories, local dining experiences, and swamp tours in New Orleans.
